retrievalProfile.description: A structured layout featuring a central photographic window against a solid black field, topped with heavy, overlapping block typography and secondary colored text.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition where a rectangular photograph of a man with an acoustic guitar is centered against an American flag, framed by a thick black border. Above the image, large-scale, heavy-weight sans-serif text is tightly tracked and vertically stacked, with the primary title in white and a secondary subtitle in contrasting red and blue-violet hues.
coreVisualRelationships: The photographic window is horizontally centered and vertically balanced within a black field.
The primary typography overlaps slightly, creating a dense, architectural block of text.
The subject's gaze is directed upward and away from the camera, suggesting inspiration.
The color palette of the text (red, white, blue) mirrors the flag within the photograph.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a mid-shot portrait centered in a rectangular frame, occupying the lower half of the total composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white block text at the top left serves as the primary entry point for the eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the bold white title down to the colored subtitle, then into the photographic window, following the subject's gaze upward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial black negative space surrounds the central elements, focusing attention on the content.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and Blue-Violet (subtitle and flag elements)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the deep black background and the bright, saturated colors of the flag and text.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' and 'T' are often enlarged or positioned to nest into adjacent characters.

typesetting.case: Mixed case for top line, All-caps for second line

composition.relationshipToImage: Positioned directly above the photo window

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and widths of the same sans-serif family to create hierarchy through scale and color.

preserve: Heavy weight of the main title
The specific red/blue color split in the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and extreme weight for the display text.
Classic Americana feel with high legibility at heavy weights.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black square canvas. In the center, place a horizontal rectangular photograph of a man with a mustache holding an acoustic guitar, with a waving American flag as the immediate background behind him.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the top left area, above the photo, add the main title in a very heavy white sans-serif font with tight tracking. Below that, add a subtitle in a bold, extended sans-serif font, using red for the first half and a light purple-blue for the second half.

verificationChecks: Is the main text white and extremely bold?
Is the photo contained within a rectangular window?
Does the subtitle use two different colors?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or album titles
Ensure the flag is a generic representation
Do not replicate specific brand logos

mustAchieve: High contrast between black and white
Clean, sharp edges on the photo window

postGenerationChecks: Check for correct color separation in subtitle
Ensure subject is centered in the photo window
Check that typography does not obscure the subject's face
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid black frame + centered rectangular photo window + stacked heavy sans-serif typography in top-left quadrant.
